acceptanceCriteria: Retain regressions for every confirmed omission in the review evidence; reachable tests must be selected or scope must be UNKNOWN.
Respect Java lexical translations/token boundaries, inherited runner discovery, generated wildcard names, and Kotlin/Java JVM names when establishing boundedness.
Run focused Java/Kotlin and seam conformance tests, obtain independent review, and retain the acceptance evidence before native completion.
body:
Confirmed review findings for V1-1308 at efc6dcff3e55e159d112c2835ed1c4f0b9748bf8. Local repro/evidence: /var/folders/zc/wb4tdm4x0c9dpkmkn8rdg9rw0000gn/T/corvint-java-review-dii2i48p/findings.md

# Review of 40c67a604b9235edf982b0fd05068dfe16348a4c..efc6dcff3e55e159d112c2835ed1c4f0b9748bf8

All confirmed cases report BOUNDED with unknown=[] while omitting a reachable test. Each includes a normal direct control test to avoid NO_SELECTABLE_TEST masking the missing dependent. Repros are retained in review_soundness_test.go and invoked via overlay.json, with no edits to repository code.

1. P1: java/java.go:408-415 qualifiedReferences requires a contiguous dotted string of at least three segments. `new p.Core()` and `new com . ex . core . Core()` / `new com.ex.core./*comment*/Core()` miss the dirty Core.java edge from a test in q. Two segments follow JAT-V0-003 literally but are an unguarded spec soundness gap; whitespace/comment cases also violate its semantic reference rule.
2. P1: java/java.go:45-47,319-326 reflection markers require punctuation adjacency. `ClassLoader.getSystemClassLoader().loadClass ("com.ex.core.Core").getDeclaredConstructor ().newInstance ();` yields neither an edge nor UnboundedReads. JAT-V0-007 requires the triggers regardless of Java whitespace/comments.
3. P1: java/java.go:227-228,253-264 and lex.go:138-144 literal Class.forName binary names do not resolve nested types. Outer.java declares Outer.Inner but `Class.forName("p.Outer$Inner")` is accepted as bounded, matches no type and does not trigger reflection. JAT-V0-003 requires the declaring file.
4. P1: java/lex.go:24-25,55-61 lexes raw bytes without Java Unicode-escape preprocessing and only ends // comments at LF. `// comment \u000a @Test void t(){new Core();}` loses executable code. CR-only `// comment\rclass MissedTest {@Test void t(){new Core();}}` does too. Both compile, yield no frontier, and erase the test signal/edge.
5. P2: java/java.go:429-432 annotation discovery requires contiguous @Name text. `@ Test void t(){new Core();}` (also @/*comment*/Test) compiles but the file is classified as a source despite a test location. JAT-V0-002 test signal is missed.
6. P1: java/java.go:340-346 requires local runner signals and never propagates inherited test discovery. `public abstract class Base {@Test public void t(){new Core();}}` plus `public class MissedTest extends Base {}` selects Base.java, omits runnable MissedTest.java, and reports BOUNDED. JAT-V0-002 itself lacks an inherited-discovery frontier; false selection of abstract Base does not provide a runnable check.
7. P1: java/java.go:215-219 a wildcard import into any observed package skips unresolved-name handling. `import com.ex.core.*; ... @Test void t(){new Generated().callCore();}` omits the test for dirty Core.java when an annotation processor supplies `Generated { public void callCore(){new Core();}}`. A single import of Generated correctly widens, but the wildcard neither sets java:unresolved-import nor an edge. This contradicts the generated-source safety claim under JAT-V0-006.
8. P1: java/kotlin.go:18-26 and kotlin/java.go:21-29 parse package headers from raw source. Kotlin `/*license*/ package p` followed by `class Bridge {fun run()=Core()}` misses java:kotlin-dependent on p/Core.java. A q.BridgeTest importing only Bridge and calling run is excluded for dirty Core.java. The inverse Java `/*license*/ package p; ... new Core()` misses kotlin:java-dependent for dirty p/Core.kt. The normal language scanners strip comments, but these new frontier scanners do not. JAT-V0-008 violated.
9. P1: kotlin/java.go:76,80-82 derives incorrect JVM names. p/core.kt is recorded as coreKt although its JVM facade is CoreKt; Java `import p.CoreKt; ... CoreKt.value()` does not set kotlin:java-dependent. `@file:kotlin.jvm.JvmName("Api")` and spaced `@file:JvmName ("Api")` also fail the exact-substring custom-facade lookup. A Kotlin direct control test permits a BOUNDED plan that excludes the Java test when the Kotlin file changes. JAT-V0-008 violated.

Verification: installed Java and Kotlin package tests pass; Kotlin real-repository ground truth skipped because its env var is unset. Shared TestSeam and TestComposedGraph checks pass. Isolated Go selection repros confirm the above omissions; Java cases compiled with installed OpenJDK 17 and a stub Test annotation (syntax validation, not JUnit runner qualification). No determinism defect observed. No full repository gate run for this read-only review.

Official semantic references: https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se17/html/jls-3.html ; https://kotlinlang.org/docs/java-to-kotlin-interop.html ; https://docs.junit.org/6.1.3/writing-tests/test-classes-and-methods.html
